sha256Bytes: Convert string into a sha256 bytestream
randomBytes: Gives variable random bytes from the entropy pool
randomU32: Gives random bytes base32'd from the entropy pool
randomU64: Gives random bytes base64'd from the entropy pool
randomString: Gives variable random strings from the entropy pool
random: Gives a random bytestream from the entropy pool
randrange: Gives a random number from 0 to the given argument.
gatherHardwareEntropy: Gives a truly random bytestream from available hardware inputs.
createDrbg: Initializes a new DRBG Pool state
createEntropyPool: Initializes a new Entropy Pool state
